_comment: Which extractor languages (src/extractors/dispatch.js LANGUAGES) are allowed to have fewer than `minTasks` labelled retrieval tasks whose expected file they extract. Coverage is DERIVED from every corpus under benchmarks/tasks/ — never declared here — so this file can only record exceptions, never claim coverage. test/integration/corpus-floor.test.js fails for a language with too few tasks and no entry below, and fails again when an entry has become unnecessary, so the lists can only shrink. An extractor with no corpus cannot regress-gate (#701).

exempt.css: styling — indexed as context, not the answer to a how-does question
exempt.dockerfile: build recipe — indexed as context, not a retrieval answer
exempt.graphql: schema definitions — context rather than the answer to a how-does question
exempt.html: markup — indexed as context, not a retrieval answer
exempt.markdown: prose — indexed as headings for context, never an implementation answer
exempt.pipeline: CI definitions — indexed so `ask` can reach them, and deliberately demoted for every query that is not about CI
exempt.powershell: shell scripting — indexed as context; no labelled answer language
exempt.properties: configuration — context, not a retrieval answer
exempt.protobuf: interface definitions — context, not a retrieval answer
exempt.shell: shell scripting — indexed as context; no labelled answer language
exempt.sql: schema/queries — context, not a retrieval answer
exempt.terraform: infrastructure configuration — context, not a retrieval answer
exempt.toml: configuration — context, not a retrieval answer
exempt.xml: configuration/markup — context, not a retrieval answer
exempt.yaml: configuration — context, not a retrieval answer

knownGaps.objc: answer language with no labelled task: no Objective-C repo in the corpus yet
knownGaps.r: answer language with no labelled task: the R benchmark repos (ggplot2, dplyr, shiny) have no task corpus
knownGaps.svelte: answer language with no labelled task whose answer is a .svelte file (the svelte repo's tasks point at .js)
knownGaps.typescript_react: answer language with no labelled task whose answer is a .tsx file
knownGaps.vue_sfc: answer language with no labelled task whose answer is a .vue file (the vue-core tasks point at .ts)
